title: Campfire SOC2 Brainpatch — Talia
content:
Context: quick freeform thinking after standup. Not official — stash of small tasks and questions to resolve before the evidence run.

Objective:
- Build a minimal evidence bundle for infra/identity/change mgmt/monitoring for the Type II window.
- Prioritize controls that auditors always poke at: user access, privileged access, change approvals, incident detection/response, backup & retention.

Top-of-mind gaps:
- API keys: inventory exists (iam-report-2026-02.csv) but we don’t have automated rotation enforcement for service keys used by on-prem connectors. Gap -> ticket INFRA-3421 assigned to Samir.
- Change approvals: PRs in runtimes repo show occasional direct pushes by ops-bot. Need policy doc + sample signed-off PRs for last 6 months. Create lightweight changelog extract.
- Evidence continuity: logging retention has a 90-day default but product required 180 for one customer; need proof of config + exception approvals.
- Vendor mgmt: third-party encryption module (VaultOps) has SLA but missing IAAs. Draft a POA&M item.

Quick control mapping (rough ids for myself):
- AC-01 (Identity lifecycle): evidence = user-provisioning-runbook.md, okta-export-2026-02.csv, onboarding-offboard-checklist.pdf; owner = HR + infra; gap = manual offboard tickets sometimes delayed. Action: propose automation for disable on termination (3wk).
- AC-02 (Privileged access): evidence = admin-role-list.csv, jupyter-root-access.log, sudoers-history.txt; owner = infra-sre; gap = a few long-lived SSH keys older than 180 days. Action: rotate keys, update vault policy, attach PR.
- CM-01 (Change mgmt): evidence = linked PRs, release notes, canary rollout logs; owner = release-engineering; gap = no consistent pre-deploy checklist for db migrations. Action: draft migration-checklist.md and request signoff from DB lead.
- IR-01 (Incident response): evidence = IR-runbook-v2.docx, postmortem-2025-11.pdf, pagerduty-flags-2026.csv; owner = sre; gap = tabletop not in last 12 months. Action: schedule 90-min tabletop and capture invite evidence.
- LM-01 (Logging & monitoring): evidence = datadog-retention-policy.pdf, alert-runbooks, trace-sample-2026-01.json; owner = observability; gap = missing correlation ids on some async worker logs. Action: logging RFC to add trace_id to worker payloads (PR 814 reference).

Open/thorny questions to triage with Samir/Elena:
1) What counts as "automated enforcement" for key rotation? Auditor will press if we say enforced. Need a clear definition + screenshot of policy in Vault/KMS.
2) For shared accounts used by legacy analytics, do we treat as SMA (service-managed accounts) or require individual identities? If we keep shared, what compensating controls to show? (detailed access logs + approval trail?)
3) Backup verification cadence — we have daily snapshots but only weekly restore drills. Will auditors accept? Plan: run one restore to staging and capture video + logs.
4) Third-party SOC reports — do we have fresh attestations for VaultOps and CloudDB? If not, get letters or compensating controls.

Mini action list (next 2 weeks):
- [ ] Pull Okta deprovisioning audit report for last 6 months (owner: Talia).
- [ ] Open automation spike ticket for key rotation enforcement (owner: Samir).
- [ ] Draft migration-checklist.md and attach to two recent DB PRs (owner: Elena).
- [ ] Schedule an IR tabletop and note attendees + minutes (owner: Talia + SRE).
- [ ] Evidence folder prep: create evidence zip skeleton with subfolders (identity/, change/, infra/, monitoring/, vendors/).

Evidence naming convention (notes):
- <control-id>_<artifact-type>_<YYYYMMDD> e.g., AC-01_okta-export_20260210.csv
- Keep one human-readable summary file per control: <control-id>_summary.txt (short description, owners, artifacts list, gaps, POA&M).

Auditor probing questions I want to rehearse:
- "Show me how you detect a compromised service key — what are the alerts and what is the runbook?" -> need a simple flow diagram + alert sample.
- "How do you demonstrate timely offboarding for an employee who left last year?" -> pick 2 examples with timestamps.
- "Provide evidence of change approvals for any DB schema change in the past 6 months" -> need PRs + approval threads.

Evidence fetch commands (notes to self):
- Okta users export: okta-cli export-users --since 2025-09-01 > okta-export-20260210.csv
- Vault policy list: vault read sys/policies/acl | jq .data > vault-policies-20260211.json
- Datadog logs for alert: datadog logs query "service:runtimes AND error" --from "2026-01-01" --to "2026-02-28" > datadog-errors-jan-feb.log

Conversation snippets (copied from Slack):
- samir: "we can glue rotation to the deploy pipeline but it will add 5% deploy time"
- elena: "migration checklist is bandaid but reduces surprise rollbacks"

Decision notes (tentative):
- For shared analytics account, implement compensating controls: mandatory time-limited tokens + elevated change approvals + daily audit digest. Document as interim control with sunset date.
- Treat VaultOps missing IAA as POA&M with target 30 days to secure vendor letter.

Random TODOs / followups:
- Add screenshots of Vault policy page (TALIA)
- Export a sample signed-off PR including review comments to evidence folder (ELENA)
- Record a 3-minute screencast of restore-to-staging (TALIA)

Notes to self: keep this doc messy. Move finalized summaries to evidence/<control-id>_summary.txt and mark this file as "brain-dump". If auditors ask for origin of doc, say: "working notes from trust-ops prep session".

End of scratchpad.
summary: Personal scratchpad for SOC2 prep capturing control mapping drafts, quick gaps, action items and auditor probes. Informal; for Talia and collaborators to convert to formal evidence bundles.
